title: Mongolian voice clip pack manifest, schemaVersion 1 (NAV-016, ADR-0010)
description: Contract between the build-time generator (backend/tools/voice-pack/, backend-engineer) and every client that plays a pack (Android NAV-016; later iOS NAV-015 and web). Normative rules that JSON Schema cannot express (canonical inventory serialisation, hashes, trim rule, join rules, byte layout of manifest.json) are in pack-format.md in this directory. A pack is valid only if it passes this schema AND those rules. The manifest never contains a token, a path outside the pack, a user name, a host name or a timestamp (NAV-016 AC 18).

schemaVersion.description: Manifest format version. Clients support exactly the versions they were built for (Android NAV-016: 1). Bumped on any breaking change to fields, trim rule or join rules.

packVersion.description: Generator input (--pack-version), never derived from the clock. Bumped for every pack whose audio differs from an earlier delivered pack of the same voice (new vendor audio, processing, bitrate, pauses). Clients do not compare it; it is a delivery and listening-record identifier.

voiceId.description: Vendor voice ID of the clips. Release and demo builds accept only FEMALE5v2 and MALE4v2 (D226, D229, NAV-016 AC 46). Stub packs use the voice ID they were generated for.

vendor.description: chimege for real packs, stub for the deterministic synthetic synthesiser (NAV-016 AC 16). recorded is reserved for a voice-talent pack (ADR-0010 §4 source b2).

apiVersion.description: Vendor API version used, e.g. v1.2. stub for the stub synthesiser.

voice.description: Voice as sent to the vendor (equals voiceId for chimege and stub).

sourceSampleRateHz.description: Sample rate requested from the vendor (NAV-016 AC 6: 22050).

container.description: Raw ADTS stream: no container edit list, so no platform trims anything; clients apply the manifest trim rule (pack-format.md §5).

sampleRateHz.description: Sample rate of the encoded clips. frames, encodedFrames and encoderDelayFrames count at this rate. 22050 by default; 16000 is the size escape hatch (ADR-0010 §3.3).

bitrateKbps.description: Target bitrate given to the encoder.

encoderDelayFrames.description: Priming frames the encoder puts before the first real sample (pinned ffmpeg aac encoder: 1024). Used by the trim rule.

encoder.description: Encoder name and version, e.g. ffmpeg-7.0.2-aac. No host or path information.

takeMethod.description: How nonFinal takes were produced (ADR-0010 §4.3). carrier-then-v1: the vendor synthesises '<spokenText>, дараа нь' and the generator cuts at the comma pause. comma-v1: experimental, '<spokenText>,' without a cut (review comparison only, never for a delivered pack).

joinPauseMs.description: Silence inserted after a distance prefix and between cont.km.* and tail.continue (NAV-016 AC 21). Default 80.

thenPauseMs.description: Silence inserted before and after join.then (NAV-016 AC 21). Default 80.

processing.description: Parameters the generator applied to every clip (NAV-016 AC 14). Informational for clients; required so a pack is reproducible.

glossaryRevision.description: sha256 (lowercase hex) of the bytes of docs/requirements/glossary-c3-spoken.tsv followed directly by the bytes of docs/architecture/voice-pack/inventory.tsv. Trace only; clients do not compare it.

inventorySha256.description: sha256 (lowercase hex) of the canonical inventory serialisation (pack-format.md §2). Clients recompute it from entries and compare it with the value compiled into the app.

entries.description: One entry per inventory entry, sorted by key then take (ASCII byte order). Exactly the inventory: no missing and no extra entries.

key.description: Segment key, e.g. dist.m.300, instr.turn.right, cont.km.120, join.then.

spokenText.description: Exact spoken text sent to the vendor for this entry (without the take-method carrier). Lower-case Mongolian Cyrillic words separated by single spaces.

file.description: Path relative to the pack directory: clips/<key>.<take>.aac.

frames.description: Exact number of PCM frames of the processed clip at codec.sampleRateHz. The player plays exactly this many frames.

encodedFrames.description: Frames a decoder produces from the whole ADTS stream when it outputs every access unit (number of AAC frames x 1024). Used by the trim rule.

sha256.description: sha256 (lowercase hex) of the file bytes.
